title: CoherentFormalModuleAffineLimitComparison
statement: Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf and $V$ an affine open with Noetherian open subscheme. For coherent formal modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] and their actual termwise restriction $\rho_V$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-restriction-objects], there is a natural isomorphism of $\Gamma(X,V)$-module inverse-system functors: levelwise sections on $V$ of a global formal module are isomorphic to top sections of $\rho_V(F)$, with scalars restricted along $V.\mathrm{topIso}^{-1}$. This includes every transition and every morphism; no completion or limit is taken.

source.place: Lemma 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine) and Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine restriction; official tag pages read during this delivery

proof.text: Construct a linear section isomorphism from restrictAppIso at top and the presheaf map isomorphism induced by V.ι_image_top. Source scalars are restricted along V.topIso.inv. smul_restrictAppIso_hom_apply and map_smul reduce linearity to cancellation of the two equality-induced top ring maps.

The inverse section comparison is presheaf transport along the opposite equality. Naturality of the underlying abelian-presheaf morphism proves its naturality in module maps. Whisker it levelwise with each formal system, then use its naturality at f.hom.app n to assemble the natural isomorphism of system functors.

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_affine_limit_comparison
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (V : X.affineOpens)
    [IsNoetherian V.1.toScheme] :
    Nonempty
      (((IsCoherentFormalModule I).ι ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ X.Modules (ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1))).obj
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation X.ringCatSheaf (op V.1))) ≅
        coherentFormalModulesRestriction I V.1 ⋙
          (IsCoherentFormalModule (I.comap V.1.ι)).ι ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ V.1.toScheme.Modules (ModuleCat Γ(X, V.1))).obj
            (SheafOfModules.evaluation V.1.toScheme.ringCatSheaf (op ⊤) ⋙
        ModuleCat.restrictScalars V.1.topIso.inv.hom))
